section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: 1. Daimler Truck & Torc Robotics Commercial Series Production
section_4b_pre_print_debates.content: Aeva's multi-year production win with Daimler Truck for autonomous commercial Class 8 freight trucks represents the largest announced FMCW LiDAR production program globally. Institutional analysts demand granular timelines on when Atlas sensor hardware transitions from pre-production testing to bill-of-materials volume procurement.

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: 2. FMCW 4D Velocity Advantage vs Traditional Time-of-Flight (ToF)
section_4b_pre_print_debates.content: Unlike legacy pulsed ToF sensors (Hesai, Luminar, Ouster), Aeva's FMCW architecture measures instantaneous velocity (Doppler) at every point in addition to 3D distance. With high-speed highway autonomous trucking requiring detection at >500 meters, analysts will grill management on whether passenger auto OEMs are adopting FMCW specifications.

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: 3. Cash Burn Trajectory vs 20.37% Short Float Squeeze Edge
section_4b_pre_print_debates.content: Operating cash outflow was -$31.17M in Q2 2026, offset by $177.88M in cash and marketable securities. With short interest at 20.37% of float ($125M+ short exposure) and options pricing a massive 22.82% move, any upside surprise in full-year guidance or commercial milestones could trigger violent forced short covering.
